verdict: RUNG: the full-vocabulary arm reproduces share_invariance's stored top1 to within 0.0000 across 40 cells (tolerance 0.05). Same quantity as F130, so the top-k arms below are a restriction of it. PRIMARY, agreement between the full-vocabulary and top-k model rankings: k=5: rho=+0.793, k=20: rho=+0.761, k=100: rho=+0.894. At or above the registered 0.6 even at k=20, so the interface preserves the ordering and the API route is viable on this readout. SECONDARY, mean absolute shift in top1: k=5: +0.0298, k=20: +0.0219, k=100: +0.0181. A preserved RANKING on shifted VALUES still means top-k numbers are not comparable to full-vocabulary ones across studies, and any published figure must name its k. BOUNDARY: 10 local models, none frontier-scale, 4 constructions, N=48. A preserved ranking says the INTERFACE is survivable; it says nothing about whether the share means the same thing on a model an order of magnitude larger. Tokenizer access, rate limits and the provider's own sampler are not simulated.
